tldr: Saturn in Sagittarius: discipline must be learned through truth, belief, and embodied wisdom.
body: With Saturn in Sagittarius, the work is testing your philosophies against lived reality. Belief has to become practice, not a speech you give when life is easier.
gift: Integrity, disciplined study, mature teaching, and principled expansion.
challenge: Dogmatism, fear of being wrong, or preaching freedom while avoiding responsibility.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
